title: Print exhibition
brief: The original delivery of eight flat boxes of framed prints to gallery goods entrance has fallen through. The art cooperative needs a replacement shipment in time for the exhibition preview. This is a single, indivisible load. Team up to book a replacement service today.

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
Hi all, Lee on the carrier side. I have four all-in services I can book today for the eight boxes as a single load, each with a fixed pickup time and a guaranteed staffed handover at the gallery goods entrance:

- V555: pickup 11:25, handover by 12:54, 47 crowns
- V490: pickup 11:12, handover by 12:15, 60 crowns
- V931: pickup 11:39, handover by 12:21, 110 crowns
- V449: pickup 11:35, handover by 12:24, 76 crowns

To pick the right one I need three things:

- Alex: what's the earliest the boxes will be packed and ready for pickup?
- Taylor: what's the latest you can receive at the goods entrance, and are there any gaps when it's unstaffed?
- Ellis: what's the budget ceiling?

My default is the cheapest service that fits everyone's times, so V555 if an 11:25 pickup and a 12:54 handover both work. Once I have your answers I'll tender and book straight away.

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
Hi all, receiving side here for the gallery goods entrance. The hard limit on my end: the load has to be handed over to a person at the goods entrance by 13:00 today at the latest. Arrival right at 13:00 is fine, anything after that I can't accept. No unattended drops, so it can't be left at the door or with a neighbour. I'll make sure someone is there to sign for all eight boxes as one delivery.

To lock in a booking, I need a few things from you:

- Alex: when will the eight boxes be packed and ready for collection?
- Lee: which services can collect after that time and guarantee arrival by 13:00, and what does each cost? A realistic ETA window helps more than a best case.
- Ellis: what's the budget ceiling so we can pick an option that clears it?

Once a service is chosen, please send me the ETA and driver contact so I can have someone at the entrance, and ask the driver to call ahead if they're running close to 13:00.

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text: I can approve up to 95 crowns all in for all eight boxes to travel together. Alex, when and where can the carrier collect them? Taylor, what delivery window works at the gallery goods entrance before the preview? Lee, once you have those times, please send a firm all-in quote and the booking cutoff so I can authorize it today.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: I can release all eight flat boxes together from 11:15 today. Lee, what’s the earliest service that can take the whole load, what would it cost, and when would it reach the gallery? Taylor, what’s the receiving window at the goods entrance, and how late can the prints arrive for the preview? Ellis, can you confirm the budget?

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
Thanks all, that gives me what I need. Putting your constraints together: Alex releases from 11:15, Taylor needs a staffed handover by 13:00, and Ellis caps spend at 95 crowns.

- V490 is out: its 11:12 pickup is before the boxes are released.
- V931 is out: 110 crowns is over the ceiling.
- V555 fits: pickup 11:25, guaranteed staffed handover by 12:54, 47 crowns.
- V449 fits: pickup 11:35, guaranteed staffed handover by 12:24, 76 crowns.

I'm tendering V555. It's the cheapest by 29 crowns and gives Alex ten minutes after release before the driver arrives. The tradeoff is margin at the gallery end: the guarantee is 12:54, only six minutes inside Taylor's 13:00 cutoff. V449 would buy a 36-minute cushion for 76 crowns, still within budget, if anyone wants that safety instead.

Before I book, please commit or object:

- Alex: confirm all eight boxes will be ready to load at 11:25.
- Taylor: confirm a 12:54 guaranteed handover is acceptable, or say if you want the earlier V449 arrival.
- Ellis: confirm you authorize 47 crowns for V555, and whether you'd also approve 76 for V449 if Taylor prefers the cushion.

Pickup times are fixed, so I need answers well before 11:25. Once booked, I'll send Taylor the ETA and driver contact and ask the driver to call ahead.

[PROPOSE: V555]

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
My constraint just changed, so I have to object to V555. Our site manager has reassigned the handover crew, and the last staffed handover I can now accept at the goods entrance is 12:30, not 13:00. There is still no unattended drop. V555's guaranteed handover of 12:54 falls after that, so nobody would be there to sign for it.

V449 works on every count as far as I can see: pickup 11:35 is after Alex's 11:15 release, the guaranteed handover of 12:24 is inside my new 12:30 limit, and 76 crowns is under Ellis's 95 ceiling. Lee, could you re-tender V449? Ellis, that would need your approval at 76 crowns, and Alex, the boxes would need to be ready to load at 11:35.

The margin at my end is only six minutes, so please have the driver call ahead if anything slips.

[HOLD: V555]

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text:
I authorize 47 crowns all in for V555. The 11:25 pickup works with Alex’s 11:15 release, and the guaranteed 12:54 handover meets Taylor’s 13:00 cutoff. If Taylor prefers the earlier handover, I can also authorize V449 at 76 crowns instead.

[APPROVE: V555]

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text:
All eight boxes will be ready to load together at 11:25. I’ll release them to the V555 driver.

[APPROVE: V555]

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
Taylor's new 12:30 limit rules out V555: its 12:54 guaranteed handover would arrive with nobody there to sign. I'm withdrawing that tender and requesting V449 instead.

V449 is the only service that now fits all three constraints:

- **Pickup 11:35:** after Alex's 11:15 release.
- **Guaranteed staffed handover by 12:24:** inside Taylor's 12:30 limit.
- **76 crowns all-in:** under Ellis's 95 ceiling, and Ellis has already said 76 can be authorized.

V490 still leaves before the boxes are released, and V931 is still over budget.

The tradeoff is 29 crowns more than V555 and only six minutes of margin at the gallery. I'll ask the driver to call Taylor ahead of arrival and send the ETA and driver contact as soon as the booking is confirmed.

Your approvals were for V555, so please ratify V449:

- **Alex:** confirm all eight boxes will be released to the V449 driver at 11:35 rather than 11:25.
- **Ellis:** confirm 76 crowns for V449.
- **Taylor:** confirm the 12:24 guaranteed handover.

[BOOK: V449]

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
I confirm V449. Its guaranteed staffed handover by 12:24 is inside my current 12:30 limit, and I'll have someone at the gallery goods entrance to sign for all eight boxes as one delivery. There is no unattended drop and nobody to receive after 12:30, so please send the ETA and driver contact once booked and have the driver call ahead if anything slips.

[APPROVE: V449]

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text:
I authorize 76 crowns all in for V449. That’s within my 95-crown limit, and the guaranteed handover by 12:24 meets Taylor’s revised 12:30 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V449]

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text:
All eight boxes will be ready by 11:15. I’ll release them together to the V449 driver at 11:35.

[APPROVE: V449]

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
Morning all, I have four replacement services I can book today, each takes the full load of eight boxes in one go, and prices are all-in:

- V555: pickup 11:25, staffed handover guaranteed by 12:54, 47 crowns
- V490: pickup 11:12, handover by 12:15, 60 crowns
- V931: pickup 11:39, handover by 12:21, 110 crowns
- V449: pickup 11:35, handover by 12:24, 76 crowns

Pickup times are fixed, so to pick the right one I need three things:

- Alex: what's the earliest the boxes will be packed and ready at your dock?
- Taylor: what's the latest you can receive at the goods entrance, and are there any gaps in staffing there?
- Ellis: what's the budget ceiling?

My preference is the cheapest service that fits everyone's limits. Once I have your answers I'll tender and book straight away.

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text: I can guarantee a staffed handover at the gallery goods entrance through 13:00 today, including 13:00 sharp. All eight flat boxes must arrive together, and someone must receive them in person. Alex, when will the load be ready? Lee, can you quote a service that guarantees handover by then? Ellis, can you confirm the budget?

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text:
Hi all, Ellis from Purchasing here. I'm the one who signs off on the cost for the replacement run of the eight boxes of framed prints, so let's get this booked today.

My hard ceiling is 95 crowns all-in, covering every fee and surcharge. I can't approve anything above that, so please quote me total figures, not base rates.

To get to a booking I need three things:

- Alex: when will all eight boxes be packed and ready for collection? It has to go as one load.
- Taylor: what hours can the goods entrance receive, and what's the latest acceptable arrival before the preview?
- Lee: once we have those windows, what services fit them, and what's the all-in price for each?

As soon as there's an option that fits the pickup and delivery windows at 95 or under, I'll approve it right away.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: I can release all eight flat boxes together from 11:15 today. That’s the earliest pickup, and the load must stay together. Taylor, when can the gallery goods entrance receive them, and what’s the latest arrival for the preview? Lee, can you quote an available service with pickup and delivery times? Ellis, what budget can you approve?

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
Thanks all, that gives me what I need. I'm tendering **V555**: pickup 11:25, staffed handover guaranteed by 12:54, 47 crowns all-in.

- **Alex:** pickup is 10 minutes after your 11:15 release. V490 is out because its 11:12 pickup is before the boxes are ready.
- **Taylor:** the guaranteed handover is 6 minutes inside your 13:00 cutoff.
- **Ellis:** 47 crowns is well under your 95 ceiling. V931 is out at 110.

The tradeoff is the slim margin at the gallery end. The only other service that fits is V449 (pickup 11:35, handover by 12:24, 76 crowns), which buys 30 minutes of extra cushion for 29 crowns more. Since the 12:54 handover is guaranteed and Taylor's entrance is staffed through 13:00, I think V555 is the right call.

Please each confirm so I can book:

- **Alex:** all eight boxes at the dock, ready to load at 11:25.
- **Taylor:** someone at the goods entrance to receive in person up to 12:54.
- **Ellis:** approval for 47 crowns all-in.

If six minutes is too tight for anyone, say so now and I'll switch the tender to V449.

[PROPOSE: V555]

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
The crew has been reassigned, so 12:30 is now the latest we can receive all eight boxes in person. V555’s 12:54 guarantee is too late, and we can’t accept an unattended drop. Lee, please tender V449. I can guarantee someone at the goods entrance for its 12:24 handover.

[HOLD: V555]

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text:
V555 works for me: 47 crowns all-in is well inside my 95 ceiling, the 11:25 pickup is after Alex's 11:15 release, and the guaranteed 12:54 handover is inside Taylor's 13:00 cutoff. I approve the 47 crowns for V555. If Alex or Taylor finds the six-minute margin too tight, V449 at 76 crowns is also within my limit and I'd approve that instead.

[APPROVE: V555]

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text:
All eight boxes will be ready at the dock from 11:15. I’ll release them together for V555’s 11:25 pickup.

[APPROVE: V555]

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
Taylor's cutoff has moved to 12:30, so V555's 12:54 handover no longer works and I'm withdrawing that tender. I'm requesting **V449** instead: pickup 11:35, staffed handover guaranteed by 12:24, 76 crowns all-in.

It is the only service left that fits all three limits:

- **Alex:** pickup at 11:35 is 20 minutes after your 11:15 release. Your approval was for V555, so please confirm all eight boxes will go together on the 11:35 pickup instead.
- **Taylor:** the guaranteed handover at 12:24 is 6 minutes inside your new 12:30 cutoff, and you've confirmed someone will be at the goods entrance.
- **Ellis:** 76 crowns is under your 95 ceiling, and you've already said you'd approve V449. Please confirm that on the board.

The other three are out: V555 arrives too late, V490 picks up before the boxes are released, and V931 is over budget.

Please each ratify V449 so the release can go ahead.

[BOOK: V449]

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
We’ll receive all eight boxes together in person at the gallery goods entrance. V449 guarantees handover by 12:24, and the crew will be there through 12:30.

[APPROVE: V449]

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text:
Taylor's cutoff moved to 12:30, so my earlier approval of V555 no longer stands. V449 at 76 crowns all-in is under my 95 ceiling, its 11:35 pickup is after Alex's 11:15 release, and the guaranteed 12:24 handover is inside Taylor's new 12:30 cutoff. I authorize 76 crowns for V449.

[APPROVE: V449]

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text:
All eight boxes will be ready at the dock from 11:15. I’ll release them together for V449’s 11:35 pickup.

[APPROVE: V449]
